SELECT b.board_no, b.community_account_no, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.board_status, b.created_at, b.updated_at, CASE WHEN b.updated_at > b.created_at THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS modified_yn, a.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD_REPLY r WHERE r.board_no = b.board_no AND r.reply_status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS reply_count FROM TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD b INNER JOIN TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT a ON a.community_account_no = b.community_account_no WHERE b.board_status = 'ACTIVE'
AND ( b.board_title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(b.board_content, #{keyword}) > 0 OR a.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY b.like_count DESC, b.board_no DESC
ORDER BY b.board_no ASC
ORDER BY b.board_no DESC

SELECT b.board_no, b.community_account_no, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.board_status, b.created_at, b.updated_at, CASE WHEN b.updated_at > b.created_at THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS modified_yn, a.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD_REPLY r WHERE r.board_no = b.board_no AND r.reply_status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS reply_count FROM TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD b INNER JOIN TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT a ON a.community_account_no = b.community_account_no WHERE b.board_no = #{board_no} AND b.board_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.board_no, b.community_account_no, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.board_status, b.created_at, b.updated_at, CASE WHEN b.updated_at > b.created_at THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS modified_yn, a.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD_REPLY r WHERE r.board_no = b.board_no AND r.reply_status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS reply_count FROM TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD b INNER JOIN TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT a ON a.community_account_no = b.community_account_no WHERE b.community_account_no = #{community_account_no} AND b.board_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY b.board_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD ( community_account_no, board_title, board_content, like_count, view_count, board_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{community_account_no}, #{board_title}, #{board_content}, 0, 0, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD SET view_count = NVL(view_count, 0) + 1 WHERE board_no = #{board_no} AND board_status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD SET board_title = #{board_title}, board_content = #{board_content}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE board_no = #{board_no} AND community_account_no = #{community_account_no} AND board_status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD SET like_count = NVL(like_count, 0) + 1 WHERE board_no = #{board_no} AND board_status = 'ACTIVE'
